questions.text: Rev 7 (your E2 = A) puts the AMI fuses straight on the bus bar's + bar: the POWER box holds the whole bus, the separate bus bar box and the 1/0 cable between them go (one heavy cable + 2 lugs fewer, 2 boxes in the glove box instead of 3). Cost: the POWER box is 62 mm deeper (180.5 x 243 mm; base 307 mm long over the feet). Pages: cad/fusebox/rev7/ST185-fusebox-rev7-summary.html vs cad/fusebox/ST185-fusebox-summary.html.

options.label: Rev 6 - separate B rev3 bus bar + POWER box

questions.topic: Rev 7: bus bar B rev3's universal bar U
questions.text: B rev3 had a third bar U (strap to + or -, or an AMG fuse). Rev 7 leaves it out: the 2 spare AMI positions and a spare M8 on the + bar cover a new feed.

options.label: Add U back in the bus zone (box about 30 mm deeper)
Only add a second spare M8 on the NEG bar

questions.topic: PDF export: notes on the small harness drawings
questions.text: R88 wants every note inside the frame of the drawing's parts. On small drawings like WheelSpeed-Front/-Rear (1530 x 780) the 5 approved notes are about 890 tall, so they don't fit without covering wires or moving parts, and moving parts would change the approved routing (R90). RearLights has the same problem. Until you pick an option, these drawings ship with bands, labels and the title block, but without the PDF export setup.

options.label: Allow one notes column right beside the drawing (page size Fit makes the sheet big enough for it); change the gate to match
Spread the parts out to make room inside the drawing (re-route; you approve the drawings again)
Cut the notes down until they fit in the gaps
